User guide · Processing officers

Full guide - Member registration process

VIFC Membership Registration and Recognition System · bo.vifc.gov.vn

Version 7 · 27 Nov 2026 · replaces version 1.0 of 11 Aug 2026

Before you start

This guide is for officers who process member registration dossiers on the internal system at bo.vifc.gov.vn: the one-stop desk, the Member Department, the Legal Department and the approving levels. The sample process is the member and enterprise registration of a single-member limited liability company.

Each task gives its purpose, ordered steps, screenshots with numbered orange frames matching the step numbers, and a Done when line. Button and menu names are in bold and written as they appear in the Vietnamese interface; the screenshots show the Vietnamese interface.

Screenshots were taken on 14 and 25 Nov 2026 on a test dossier with test accounts; figures shown are sample data. A chaptered clip of the same process is on guideline.vifc.gov.vn under Officer.

Systems and roles

ModuleAddressUsed for
Internal homebo.vifc.gov.vnEntering the modules and seeing items waiting for you.
QL Yêu Cầu (Request)workflow.vifc.gov.vnReceiving submitted dossiers; creating, sending and approving forms.
QL Hồ sơ (Work)work.vifc.gov.vnFollowing a dossier through its stages, assigning and doing sub-tasks, creating linked forms.
Thành viên (Member)crm.vifc.gov.vnCreating an enterprise, issuing its portal account, viewing the member list.
Member Informationmember.vifc.gov.vn/member-informationPublic page for looking up published members.
RoleMain workTask cards
One-stop deskChecks a new dossier: requests a supplement or confirms it is complete.HD.CB.07
Head, deputy head of the Member DepartmentApproves forms at the head / deputy step.HD.CB.13
Member Department officerOwns the dossier through all stages: creates the enterprise and its account, assigns sub-tasks, prepares the appraisal report, dossier receipt, decision and certificate forms; moves the dossier between stages.HD.CB.05, HD.CB.08 - HD.CB.12
Legal DepartmentThe head is assigned the Legal Department opinion task and adds an officer; the officer gives an opinion, uploads the file and marks it done.HD.CB.08, HD.CB.09
PresidiumApproves the decision, the submission and form B2.HD.CB.13
  • Internal accounts are shared across modules according to permissions.
  • The Ho Chi Minh City and Da Nang offices work the same way; the system routes by the receiving office the applicant selected.
  • Process only dossiers assigned to you; every change is recorded in the history.

Creating an enterprise and issuing its portal account is done in the Member module (crm.vifc.gov.vn): open member management, create the enterprise with its identification and contact details, create the account and send the sign-in details to the enterprise.

Processing dossiers

See what needs your action

HD.CB.01

Know which dossiers are waiting for you and which are close to their deadline.

  1. In the left bar, click Request. The Dashboard of the Request module opens.
  2. Four counters at the top: Overdue, Due today, In Progress, Following.
  3. The In Progress panel lists each dossier with its status, sender and the DUE TO line.
  4. The My requests and Processed panels on the right show dossiers you created and dossiers you have handled.
  5. Click a dossier name in the In Progress panel to open it.

Done when the dossier detail page opens.

Open and review a dossier

HD.CB.02

Read the declared content, attachments and routing history of a dossier.

  1. The procedure name is at the top. The DECLARATION PROGRESS panel on the left lists the sections of the form.
  2. Click a section, or click Next, to read what the applicant declared.
  3. Scroll down to the attachments section to see documents by group; you can download the whole set there.
  4. At the bottom, the routing table shows which steps the dossier has passed, who handled it, when, and the action taken.

Done when you have read every section and attachment and know which step the dossier is at.

If you see: Downloading the whole set returns an error - Download the files one by one in the attachments section.

Decide at your step

HD.CB.03

Move the dossier forward, return it for supplementation, or reject it.

  1. The action buttons are on the top bar of the detail page.
  2. Write your remarks in the Note box below the form before clicking a button.
  3. Dossier complete: click Complete dossier.
  4. Dossier incomplete or incorrect: click Need more Info; state what is missing in the Note box.
  5. Dossier not eligible: click Return.
  6. Not decided yet: click Save to keep what you wrote, or Exit to leave.

Done when the routing table shows a new row with your action.

If you see: Need more Info asks you to fill in the note - Type your remarks in the Note box and click again.

Tracking

Follow dossiers in Dossier management

HD.CB.04

See dossiers in progress, items you follow and recent status changes.

  1. In the left bar, click Application (QL Hồ sơ in Vietnamese). The dossiers-in-progress page opens.
  2. Three counters at the top: to process, following, and processed.
  3. The dossier list shows each dossier with its deadline, progress and status; a search box and a filter button sit at the top right of the table.
  4. The recent-activity panel records who changed which dossier from which status to which.
  5. Under the dossier catalogue on the left, click ĐĂNG KÝ THÀNH VIÊN to open the member-registration group.

Done when you can read the latest status of a dossier in the recent-activity panel.

Members and lookup

Add a member and issue its portal account

HD.CB.05

A Member Department officer creates the enterprise in the Member module and issues the account it uses to sign in to member.vifc.gov.vn and submit a dossier.

  1. Open the Thành viên module (crm.vifc.gov.vn). Type the enterprise name in the Tìm kiếm box of Danh sách thành viên to make sure it does not exist yet.
  2. Click Thêm at the top right.
  3. In the THÀNH VIÊN form, enter Tên thành viên (required) and the contact details: short name, head office address, phone, Email chung.
  4. Click Lưu. The enterprise appears in the member list.
  5. Click the new enterprise name to reopen it and choose the Tài khoản tab.
  6. Click Thêm mới. Enter Tên tài khoản, Password and Email; check that Công ty/Tổ chức shows the right enterprise, then click Lưu.
  7. The account shows in the table on the Tài khoản tab. Send the user name and password to the enterprise contact through a private channel and ask them to change the password at first sign-in.

Done when the enterprise can sign in to member.vifc.gov.vn with the new account.

If you see: Clicking Thêm mới on the Tài khoản tab opens an empty form with no fields - Reload the page and try again. If it is still empty, ask the system administrator to check your permission to create accounts.

If you see: The enterprise cannot sign in - Open the enterprise's Tài khoản tab and check the user name and email; remind them to sign in at member.vifc.gov.vn.

If you see: The investor did not receive the email with the user name and password. - The email may be late or in spam. Check the Email on the enterprise's Tài khoản tab, then send the user name and password to the contact through a private channel and ask them to change the password at first sign-in.

Look up enterprise information

HD.CB.06

See an enterprise's registration information and dossiers by its enterprise code.

  1. In the left bar, click the enterprise lookup item, shown as Business l… (Tra cứu doanh nghiệp in Vietnamese). The enterprise and dossier lookup page opens.
  2. Enter the enterprise code in the search box.
  3. Click the search button to the right of the box. The result has three parts: basic enterprise information, the enterprise's dossier list, and dossier details.
  4. The quick-sample row offers a few sample codes; click one to fill the box.

Done when the screen returns results for the code you entered.

If you see: I need to check whether a proposed name is already taken - Use Kiểm tra tên công ty in QL Yêu Cầu (card HD.CB.15). Tra cứu doanh nghiệp only searches by enterprise code.

Check for a duplicate enterprise name

HD.CB.15

Check whether a proposed enterprise name duplicates one already in the National Business Registration Database.

  1. Open Request and click Check company name in the left list. The page Enterprise Name Search & Verification opens.
  2. Type the name in Proper Name (excluding enterprise type) (required). Enter only the proper name, for example ABC, without LLC, JSC and the like.
  3. Optionally fill in Full Vietnamese Name, Abbreviated Name and Foreign Name to check them as well.
  4. Click Check company name and wait while the system queries the national database. The result appears right below the form. To check another name, click Reset.

Done when a result panel appears below the form. For a usable name it reads COMPANY NAME IS VALID (NOT DUPLICATED) and each line - Full Name, Proper Name, Abbreviated Name, Foreign Name - shows Available / Not duplicated.

If you see: "Kiểm tra không thành công" appears with an LGSP timeout - Click the retry button. The external lookup service is sometimes slow; if it still fails, try again in a few minutes and tell the Technology Department if it persists.

If you see: The Check company name button keeps spinning - The system is waiting for the national database, which can take more than 15 seconds. Wait for the result or an error message.

Member registration flow

Receive a dossier, request a supplement

HD.CB.07

The one-stop desk checks a newly submitted dossier: return it for a supplement, or confirm it is complete so it moves on to appraisal.

  1. Open QL Yêu Cầu (Request). A new dossier sits in the Cần xử lý panel with the label Chờ phê duyệt. Click its name to open it.
  2. Read the declared content using the TIẾN TRÌNH KÊ KHAI panel. The toolbar offers Hồ sơ đầy đủ (complete), Bổ sung thông tin (request supplement), Chuyển xử lý (reassign) and Từ chối (reject).
  3. Scroll to Ý kiến and Đính kèm to see the applicant's note and each document by group.
  4. If something is missing: click Bổ sung thông tin. In Người được yêu cầu bổ sung choose the applicant; in Ý kiến state exactly what must be added.
  5. Click the Bổ sung thông tin button at the top right of the dialog to send. The dossier returns to the applicant; once they resubmit, it comes back to your Cần xử lý panel.
  6. If the dossier is complete: click Hồ sơ đầy đủ, then Tiếp tục in the Xác nhận dialog.

Done when the dossier moves to your Đã xử lý panel and appears in QL Hồ sơ with the status Thẩm định.

If you see: The enterprise has submitted but I cannot see the dossier in QL Hồ sơ. - A new dossier first sits at the one-stop step: look in QL Yêu Cầu, Cần xử lý, of whoever holds that step. Only after Hồ sơ đầy đủ does it appear in QL Hồ sơ with status Thẩm định.

Assign appraisal tasks

HD.CB.08

The Member Department officer in charge of the dossier assigns each sub-task of the Thẩm định stage to the right person, depending on the task.

  1. Open QL Hồ sơ (Work). The dossier just received is in Danh sách hồ sơ with the status Thẩm định. Click its name. You follow this dossier through all its stages.
  2. Click the Mô tả bước line to read what this stage requires.
  3. The Công việc con section lists the stage's sub-tasks, each at Chờ thực hiện. Click a sub-task name to open it.
  4. Inside the sub-task, click Chọn người xử lý. In the Chỉnh sửa người xử lý dialog, type the assignee's name, select it and click Lưu. Choose by task: for Lấy ý kiến Ban Pháp chế add the head of the Legal Department; for work done by the Member Department, such as the appraisal report or the supervisory authority's opinion, do it yourself or add another officer.
  5. The assignee shows under the sub-task title. The head of the Legal Department opens the assigned task and adds an officer from their own department the same way.

Done when every sub-task has an assignee.

If you see: I cannot open or work on a sub-task. - You are not a handler of that task. Ask the officer in charge of the dossier to open it, click Chọn người xử lý and add you.

Do an assigned task and mark it done

HD.CB.09

An officer picks up a sub-task, attaches the result, adds a comment and marks it done.

  1. Open QL Hồ sơ. Your task shows right under the dossier name, type Task. Click the task name.
  2. The sub-task screen has Đính kèm (attachments), Quy trình - Công việc liên quan and Công việc con; the Bình luận box on the right is for your comment.
  3. Click the + next to Đính kèm, choose Loại tài liệu, add a note, choose the file and click Upload.
  4. Click the status box at the top right and choose Đang thực hiện when you start.
  5. When finished, click the status box again and choose Đã hoàn tất.

Done when on the dossier, the sub-task carries the label Đã hoàn tất with its completion time.

If you see: Changing the dossier status shows "Bạn phải hoàn thành tất cả công việc con trước khi chuyển trạng thái". - A sub-task is still open. Open each one under Công việc con, set its status to Đã hoàn tất, then change the dossier status again.

Issue the dossier receipt

HD.CB.10

Issue the receipt recording the date received and the promised result date, linked to the dossier.

  1. In the dossier at the Thẩm định stage, under Quy trình - Công việc liên quan, click PHIẾU TIẾP NHẬN HỒ SƠ. The form opens in a new tab.
  2. Enter Nội dung, then pick Ngày tiếp nhận hồ sơ and Ngày hẹn trả kết quả from the calendar (these two boxes do not accept typing).
  3. Click Tiếp nhận hồ sơ to save. The form gets a code and a Gửi button appears.
  4. Click Gửi. The Thông tin xử lý dialog shows which steps the form will pass through.
  5. Click Đồng ý to send.

Done when the receipt shows in the dossier under PHIẾU TIẾP NHẬN HỒ SƠ with its code and the label Phê duyệt.

Submit the approval decision

HD.CB.11

Move the dossier to Ra quyết định, prepare the member registration approval decision and submit it for approval.

  1. When the sub-tasks are done, click the status box at the top right of the dossier and choose Ra quyết định.
  2. At the new stage, Quy trình - Công việc liên quan offers two forms. Click QUYẾT ĐỊNH CHẤP THUẬN ĐĂNG KÝ THÀNH VIÊN (approve) or QUYẾT ĐỊNH TỪ CHỐI (refuse).
  3. Scroll to Đính kèm and click Chọn files on the Báo cáo thẩm định line (required) to attach the appraisal report.
  4. Fill in Về việc, Căn cứ and Nội dung, then click Lưu and Gửi.
  5. In the Thông tin xử lý dialog, choose the approver for Trưởng / phó ban and Ban Chủ Tịch, add a comment if needed, and click Đồng ý.

Done when on the dossier, the decision form carries the label Phê duyệt with the approval time, after the head of department agrees and the Presidium approves.

If you see: The Thông tin xử lý dialog does not list the person you need - Ask the system administrator to add that person to the matching step of the form. Then create a new form: a draft created earlier does not pick up the new list.

If you see: A step already lists several people and has no Chọn box - Click the step name (blue text). The Chọn người xử lý dialog opens; remove the people not needed for this form and click Đồng ý.

If you see: Changing the dossier status shows "Bạn phải hoàn thành tất cả công việc con trước khi chuyển trạng thái". - A sub-task is still open. Open each one under Công việc con, set its status to Đã hoàn tất, then change the dossier status again.

Issue the certificate and close the dossier

HD.CB.12

Prepare the forms of the Cấp giấy chứng nhận stage, finish the sub-tasks and close the dossier.

  1. Once the approval decision is approved, click the status box and choose Cấp giấy chứng nhận. (The other option is for a dossier that does not qualify.)
  2. Click Mô tả bước to read the stage's tasks: prepare the certificate, attach the file for the enterprise type, and move to Hoàn thành once it is approved.
  3. Quy trình - Công việc liên quan offers three forms: B2: KIỂM TRA VÀ XÁC NHẬN THÔNG TIN GIẤY CHỨNG NHẬN, THÔNG BÁO GIẤY CHỨNG NHẬN ĐẾN THÀNH VIÊN and TỜ TRÌNH GIẤY CHỨNG NHẬN. Click each button to create one.
  4. For form B2: choose Loại giấy chứng nhận, enter the company name, Thành phố (Tiếng anh) and Ngành nghề kinh doanh chính (required), click Xác nhận to save, then Gửi.
  5. When sending the Tờ trình, the Thông tin xử lý dialog lists the people at each step. Click a step name (blue text) to open Chọn người xử lý, keep only the approver, and click Đồng ý.
  6. Do sub-tasks B1 and B3; for B3 you must create THÔNG BÁO GIẤY CHỨNG NHẬN ĐẾN THÀNH VIÊN with every field filled in, so the enterprise shows on the Member portal. When the forms are approved and B1 and B3 are Đã hoàn tất, click the status box and choose Hoàn thành.

Done when the dossier shows the status Hoàn thành and a completion date at the bottom of the screen.

If you see: The Thông tin xử lý dialog does not list the person you need - Ask the system administrator to add that person to the matching step of the form. Then create a new form: a draft created earlier does not pick up the new list.

If you see: A step already lists several people and has no Chọn box - Click the step name (blue text). The Chọn người xử lý dialog opens; remove the people not needed for this form and click Đồng ý.

If you see: The dossier is Hoàn thành but the enterprise does not show on the Member portal - Do sub-task B3: Cập nhật sổ đăng ký thành viên và Công bố. Within B3 you must create the form THÔNG BÁO GIẤY CHỨNG NHẬN ĐẾN THÀNH VIÊN and fill in every field: member, identification code, certificate type, first registration date, charter capital, main business line, head office address, plus the member certificate file, then send it. After publishing, check the Member Information page: member.vifc.gov.vn/member-information, or from the vifc.gov.vn home page open Member & Ecosystem, choose Member Information, and search the company name or code.

If you see: You send the certificate notice but the Thành viên step has no recipient - Check the Thành viên box on the form. This step takes its recipient from the selected member; if it is left empty the form ends at the creator and the applicant receives nothing.

If you see: Does the system generate the certificate from the template? - Yes, at the Cấp giấy chứng nhận stage. Fill in form B2 and the other forms of this stage; the certificate takes its data from them.

Approve a submitted form

HD.CB.13

Heads, deputy heads and the Presidium review and approve forms submitted by officers.

  1. Open QL Yêu Cầu. Forms waiting for you are in the Cần xử lý panel with the label Chờ phê duyệt; the Cần xử lý counter above shows how many remain.
  2. For the full list, open Phê duyệt in the left bar and choose Chờ phê duyệt.
  3. Click a form name to open it. Read the content, the submitter's Ý kiến and the documents under Đính kèm.
  4. On a waiting form the toolbar shows the approval button: Đồng ý for heads and deputy heads, Phê duyệt for the Presidium; to refuse, click Từ chối. Then choose Tiếp tục in the Xác nhận dialog.
  5. Scroll to the bottom: the Thông tin luân chuyển table records each step: handler, completion time, action and comment.

Done when the form leaves Chờ phê duyệt, appears under Phê duyệt - Đã xử lý, and the routing table records your action.

Heads and approvers

Delegate approval

HD.CB.16

Let someone else approve the forms submitted to you for a period of time.

  1. Open QL Yêu Cầu (Request) and click Ủy quyền phê duyệt (delegate approval) in the left list. The page lists current delegations.
  2. Click Thêm mới (add) at the top right. The Thêm mới dialog opens.
  3. Choose Người được ủy quyền (delegate) and Ngày hiệu lực (effective date), both required. Ngày hết hạn (expiry), Yêu cầu (request type) and Mô tả (description) are optional.
  4. Click Thêm to save, or Hủy to cancel.

Done when the delegation table shows a new row with the delegator, the delegate, the effective date and the expiry date.

If you see: Ủy quyền phê duyệt is not visible - It is inside QL Yêu Cầu, right below the Phê duyệt group in the left list.

Reject a submitted form

HD.CB.18

Return a form to its author with a reason when the submission is not acceptable.

  1. Open the form awaiting your approval from the Cần xử lý panel and read its content and attachments. The action buttons are in the top bar.
  2. Click Từ chối (reject) in the top bar. The Từ chối dialog opens.
  3. Write the reason in the Ý kiến (opinion) box. It is required.
  4. Click Từ chối in the dialog to confirm. The system returns you to the home page.

Done when the routing table of the form shows the action Từ chối with your opinion, and the form goes back to its author to fix and resend.

If you see: Bấm nhầm Từ chối ở thanh nút - Bấm dấu X ở góc hộp Từ chối để đóng; phiếu giữ nguyên trạng thái chờ duyệt.

If you see: Clicked Từ chối in the top bar by mistake - Click the X at the corner of the dialog to close it; the form stays awaiting approval.

Administration

Getting to know the admin area

HD.CB.17

Know what the admin area holds and view the list of forms running on the system. For system administrator accounts.

  1. In the left bar, click Quản trị (admin). Only accounts with admin rights see it. The Bảng biểu (dashboard) page opens.
  2. Read the Bảng biểu page: the Yêu cầu panel shows total request types, total forms, drafts and forms awaiting approval; other panels show accounts and tasks.
  3. Open Thiết kế yêu cầu and click Yêu cầu động. The table lists every form with its title, English title, code, category and creation right.
  4. Find a form with the Tìm kiếm theo Tiêu đề box or the Lọc (filter) button. Editing forms and approval flows is done by the Technology Department; do not click the bin icon at the end of a row.
  5. Other items in the left list: Danh mục (catalogues), Thiết kế báo cáo (report design), Lịch sử đăng nhập (sign-in history), Lịch sử hoạt động (activity history), Cấu hình (settings).

Done when you find the form you need in the Yêu cầu động table.

If you see: Quản trị is missing from the left bar - Your account has no admin rights. Contact the Technology Department if you need a setting checked.

Reference

Sub-task statuses

StatusMeaning
Chờ thực hiệnNot started.
Đang thực hiệnIn progress; content, files and comments can be added.
Đã hoàn tấtFinished with a result. Move to the next stage only when all sub-tasks are Đã hoàn tất.

Branching at the decision stage

Expected outcomeForm to createAfter approval
RecognisedQUYẾT ĐỊNH CHẤP THUẬN ĐĂNG KÝ THÀNH VIÊNChange the status to Cấp giấy chứng nhận.
Not recognisedQUYẾT ĐỊNH TỪ CHỐIChange the status to Hồ sơ không đủ điều kiện and close.

Checks before moving to the next stage

  • Right dossier, right receiving office, right person in charge.
  • Every sub-task has a result or supporting file.
  • Only one decision form is used; it went to the right approvers and is approved.
  • The certificate has the right type, name, code, address, capital and representative.
  • B3 includes the certificate notice to the member with every field filled in.

Common situations

SituationWhat to do
A dossier or form is not visibleCheck the bell, the Cần xử lý panel in QL Yêu Cầu and the list in QL Hồ sơ; check filters and whether it is assigned to you.
The dossier status cannot be changedFinish every sub-task and required form of the stage; read the error message on screen.
The wrong decision form was chosenStop and do not send. A saved draft still shows on the dossier as Chờ phê duyệt; ask the system administrator to remove it, then create the right form.
Wrong or missing approverCheck the Thông tin xử lý dialog before clicking Đồng ý; choose the person at each step, or click the step name to remove people. If someone is missing, ask the administrator to add them, then create a new form.
The dossier is Hoàn thành but the enterprise does not show on the Member portalDo B3: create THÔNG BÁO GIẤY CHỨNG NHẬN ĐẾN THÀNH VIÊN with every field filled in, then check the Member Information page.

Glossary

TermMeaning
QL Yêu CầuWhere dossiers are received and forms are processed.
QL Hồ sơWhere internal dossiers are managed by stage.
